description: South Korea acquisition tax on land, shops and other non-housing property: 4% purchase (3% farmland), 3.5% gift, 2.8% inheritance or new construction, plus rural special tax (0.2%) and local education tax ((rate - 2%) x 20%). Totals 4.6%, 3.4%, 4.0%, 3.16%. Inherited farmland, reliefs and heavy rates are not modeled.

price.description: Tax base: purchase price, or market value for a gift or inheritance (KRW)
